title: Extraction spec for photo-derived Aokigahara material packs
notes: rect = [x0,y0,x1,y1] in photo pixels; rotation_deg positive = counter-clockwise as displayed; core = [w,h] taken from the centre of the rotated rect; tile_px is the 1k size (master = x4). physical_scale_m is the ESTIMATED width of the source crop. Photos are relative to construction_inputs/uhd_photos/. chroma = linear-chroma multiplier applied after delighting (phone HDR frame U15 is oversaturated).

materials.scale_basis: pale surface root just right of the region ~0.08 m thick = 80 px; hummock ~0.7 m across
materials.notes: cushion/feather moss carpet on a lava hummock with twigs and needle debris, shade-lit; the pale root to the right is excluded; ground plane seen obliquely so the tile is stretched ~1.3x vertically
continuous moss carpet draped over buttress roots at a trunk base (phone close-up, softer source)

materials.scale_basis: trunk in the same frame ~0.37 m = 200 px at similar depth
materials.notes: rounded moss-covered hummock in even shade, the cleanest moss surface in the set; small source region (260 px) so the 4k tier is heavily interpolated

mossy lava blocks of the dry-stone trail retaining wall in U10 seen face-on (square crop for the runtime rock slot); the block ARRANGEMENT is anthropogenic, the surfaces are natural Jogan lava with moss
dry-stone trail retaining wall of mossy lava blocks seen face-on; block arrangement is anthropogenic; 2:1 tile, no stretch
fallen broadleaf leaves, conifer needles and thin twigs on dark humus, even shade

lichen-plated grey-brown bark with pale foliose lichen and thin dark fissures; trunk leans 4 deg so the region is rotated before cropping

arching mossy surface root: moss cushion on the upper face, bare fissured root bark on the flank (phone close-up)
low evergreen small-leaved shrub carpet; specular leaf highlights are masked and inpainted; not consumed by the runtime (no ground-cover layer yet)
